name: OpenClaw
author: team@cyra.systems
description: OpenClaw — multi-channel agent gateway + CLI. Bridges chat channels (Telegram, Discord, Slack, Mattermost, Zalo, Twitch) to LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama) and tools. This egg clones the upstream repo, installs pnpm + Bun build deps, builds the runtime bundle, and boots the gateway on the server's allocated port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenClaw installation script (Pelican / Pterodactyl egg)
# Runs inside the installer container. Writes files to /mnt/server,
# which becomes /home/container at runtime.
set -eo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  curl git ca-certificates python3 make g++ unzip openssl tini

# Install Bun (required by openclaw build scripts). Retry on transient fails.
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  if curl --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash; then
    break
  fi
  [ "$attempt" -eq 5 ] && exit 1
  sleep $((attempt * 2))
done
export PATH="/root/.bun/bin:${PATH}"

corepack enable

OPENCLAW_GIT_URL="${OPENCLAW_GIT_URL:-https://github.com/Cyra-Systems/openclaw.git}"
OPENCLAW_GIT_REF="${OPENCLAW_GIT_REF:-main}"

cd /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
  echo "==> Updating existing checkout to ${OPENCLAW_GIT_REF}"
  git remote set-url origin "${OPENCLAW_GIT_URL}"
  git fetch --prune origin
  git reset --hard "origin/${OPENCLAW_GIT_REF}" || git reset --hard "${OPENCLAW_GIT_REF}"
else
  echo "==> Cloning ${OPENCLAW_GIT_URL} @ ${OPENCLAW_GIT_REF}"
  git init -q
  git remote add origin "${OPENCLAW_GIT_URL}"
  git fetch --depth=1 origin "${OPENCLAW_GIT_REF}"
  git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
fi

echo "==> Installing node_modules with pnpm (frozen lockfile)"
NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=2048" pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

echo "==> Building A2UI bundle (non-fatal on failure)"
pnpm canvas:a2ui:bundle || {
  echo "    A2UI bundle unavailable on this arch — creating stub"
  mkdir -p src/canvas-host/a2ui
  echo "/* A2UI bundle unavailable in this build */" > src/canvas-host/a2ui/a2ui.bundle.js
  echo "stub" > src/canvas-host/a2ui/.bundle.hash
}

echo "==> Building server bundle"
pnpm build:docker

echo "==> Building UI (non-fatal)"
OPENCLAW_PREFER_PNPM=1 pnpm ui:build || true

echo "==> Pruning dev deps"
CI=true NPM_CONFIG_FROZEN_LOCKFILE=false pnpm prune --prod || true

echo "==> Preparing runtime state directory"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.openclaw

# Generate a gateway token if the user did not supply one. Never overwrite
# an existing token. Stored in ~/.openclaw/.env which openclaw reads on boot.
if [ -z "${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN:-}" ] && [ ! -s /mnt/server/.openclaw/.env ]; then
  GEN_TOKEN="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
  {
    echo "# Auto-generated by Pelican egg installer"
    echo "OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=${GEN_TOKEN}"
  } > /mnt/server/.openclaw/.env
  chmod 600 /mnt/server/.openclaw/.env
  echo "    Generated gateway token at ~/.openclaw/.env"
fi

# Yolks runtime UID/GID.
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server || true

echo "==> OpenClaw installation complete."

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Upstream Git URL to clone. Override to deploy a fork or private mirror.

variables.name: Git Ref (Branch / Tag / SHA)
variables.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to check out during install / reinstall.

variables.name: Gateway Bind Mode
variables.description: Where the gateway listens. 'loopback' = 127.0.0.1 (only reachable from inside the container), 'lan' = 0.0.0.0 (reachable via the Wings port mapping). Use 'lan' for normal panel usage.

variables.name: Gateway Auth Token
variables.description: Bearer token required to call the gateway. Leave blank to have OpenClaw auto-generate one on first start (stored in ~/.openclaw/.env). Generate a strong value with: openssl rand -hex 32. Required when binding beyond loopback.

variables.name: Gateway Auth Password (alt)
variables.description: Optional alternative to the token-based auth. Use either a token OR a password, not both.

variables.name: Allow Insecure Private WS
variables.description: Set to 1 to allow the gateway's private WebSocket on plaintext (non-TLS). Leave empty in production; only useful for local/dev deployments.

variables.name: State Directory Override
variables.description: Optional override for the OpenClaw state directory. Defaults to ~/.openclaw inside the container.

variables.name: Config Path Override
variables.description: Optional override path for openclaw.json. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.

variables.name: Load Shell Env
variables.description: Set to 1 to import missing keys from the login shell profile at startup.

variables.name: Shell Env Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Milliseconds to wait when sourcing the login shell profile for env vars.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone for log timestamps inside the container.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: API key for OpenAI.

variables.description: API key for Anthropic (Claude).

variables.description: API key for Google Gemini / AI Studio.
